messages:
elaine: T-minus 72hrs for the public announce. Need final changelog link, docs anchors, exact rollout windows for canary + full, and confirmation on the webinar RSVP CTA. Who can lock?

sam: I can take the changelog + rollout timings. Will sync with infra today.

elaine: Awesome. Please post the changelog permalink here once it's frozen. Marketing will grab the anchor for the release post and the email snippet.

pranav: Heads up — canary is planned in two waves: internal canary (team-only) at 09:00 PT Mon, then 10% public at 13:00 PT Mon, full rollout by 18:00 PT Mon if metrics look good. Need a 30m buffer for rollback window.

elaine: Perfect, that timing works for the webinar (13:30 PT). We'll avoid cutover during live demo. Can you add the rollback window to the runbook?

sam: Adding now. Changelog draft is at https://redwood.example.com/changelog/2026-03-21-draft -- permalink will be the same when we freeze.

maria: Marketing note: update on-website anchor id should be #what-is-rolling so social cards link to the details section. Also need 1-sentence TL;DR for the top of the docs.

elaine: TL;DR: "New adaptive batching & route-aware fallbacks reduce latency by up to 2x for steady-state workloads; rollout will occur region-by-region with canary first." Can you tuck that into the docs intro, @sam?

sam: Yep, will paste into docs intro and push when changelog is frozen.

pranav: Deploy bot will post status during rollout. @deploy-bot can you add a verbose channel update?

deploy-bot: will monitor. Posting deploy updates to #release-war-room and pinging on failures >= P2.

elaine: Webinar ops — we have 250 RSVPs. Need a slide that shows before/after latency & cost tradeoffs. Can we get benchmark snapshots from the perf team?

sam: I'll export bench snapshots and put them in the shared folder: https://drive.redwood.com/launch/benchmarks/ob-2026. Expect CSV + PNG by EOD.

maria: For inbound lead routing: marketing will tag demo requests from the webinar with campaign=orbit-launch and route to AE queue "orbit-webinar". Can ops confirm the webhook is ready?

pranav: Yes — webhook tested in staging. I'll flip it to prod after canary completes.

elaine: Last: please post the frozen changelog permalink and docs link by 17:00 PT today so we can schedule the scheduled social posts / email. Anything blocking?

sam: No blockers. Will post link here when frozen. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll draft the email body once changelog link is in. Planning 1 short announcement + 1 follow-up with benchmarks.

elaine: Great — thanks team. We'll run the final preflight 2hr before internal canary in #release-war-room. :rocket:
